headline: Goal: ship VipInvitoz production-ready on Vercel Pro. Core Intent: remove mobile/UX blockers (hamburger nav, per-ceremon
taskDescription: Goal: ship VipInvitoz production-ready on Vercel Pro. Core Intent: remove mobile/UX blockers (hamburger nav, per-ceremony palette, resilient mobile image upload incl. HEIC), unblock VIP test account, keep infra on sub-minute crons after Pro upgrade — so smoke test tomorrow can exercise full signup → ceremony → invite → RSVP flow.
currentStatus: Done: 5 commits pushed to main (daily-cron revert, */1 cron restore post-Pro, mobile hamburger drawer, per-ceremony invitation palette with 5 presets + DEUIL lock, client-side downscale + HEIC/HEIF accept). Prisma Ceremony.invitationPalette column pushed directly to shared Neon DB (dev=prod). VIP upgrade applied to foadjoraoul@yahoo.de via scratchpad script (FREEMIUM 2 credits → VIP unlimited, expires 2027-11-14). Vercel auto-deploys live at vip-invitoz.vercel.app. Pending: user must set UPLOAD_ALLOWED_MIME env var in Vercel to include image/heic,image/heif + optional UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES=26214400, then redeploy without cache — reason: env-var defaults to 3 MIMEs only, HEIC uploads 415 otherwise. i18n P0 not started (next-intl installed, not configured).
keyDecisions: Decision: Vercel Pro $20/mo — Reason: Hobby forbids commercial SaaS + 10s timeout kills Anthropic AI calls (15-30s) + Hobby cron floor is daily (delays verification emails up to 24h)
Decision: Ship palette feature all-in-one (Prisma column + 5 presets + picker + preview + public page) — Reason: user chose 'Option simple' over decomposed ceremonyTone-first path

Decision: Palette lives in editor with smart auto-default per ceremony type + free override + server-side DEUIL lock via coercePaletteForType — Reason: each ceremony has its own tone, settings page would force global choice
Decision: 5 palette IDs stored as Prisma String (not enum) — Reason: adding new presets requires no DB migration

Decision: Client-side downscale in lib/upload-client.ts before FormData append (canvas 2000px max, JPEG q=0.85, skip HEIC/HEIF→server handles via heic-convert) — Reason: phone photos routinely 5-15 MB, exceeded default 10 MB server cap
Decision: Shared Neon DB between dev and prod (Option A) — Reason: solo-dev MVP speed; additive schema changes (new column with @default) safe, renames/drops risky
Decision: Narrow i18n from FR/EN/DE (original PRD) to FR/EN only — Reason: user call to cut scope
Decision: Close mobile drawer via per-Link onClick rather than useEffect(pathname) — Reason: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps rule not configured in flat ESLint, disable-comment itself errored
userContribution: User paid for Vercel Pro upgrade ($20/mo, team fluxiateam) after seeing Hobby limits. Reviewed and approved palette picker location decision ('Option simple' + 'parametrage dans editor' pushback). Narrowed i18n scope from PRD FR/EN/DE to FR/EN only. Identified mobile upload failure on real iPhone and asked for VIP upgrade of test account + larger upload cap — three asks in one message. Picked A/B options when offered. Scheduled the 9am Berlin smoke-test reminder routine.
